name: codeledger
description: ContextECF CodeLedger: deterministic context selection for AI coding agents. Scores every file across 10 signals and delivers a minimal, ranked context bundle — so your agent reads the right files first. Install the CLI from @codeledger/cli.

tools.name: get_activation_payload
tools.description: CALL THIS FIRST. Activates CodeLedger for a task, selects the relevant file bundle, and returns the exact next steps. Required session-start step.

tools.name: query_ledger
tools.description: Find relevant patterns and prior solutions from this codebase's history

tools.name: get_active_context
tools.description: Get the current file selection for the active task

tools.name: record_interaction
tools.description: Record the outcome of a task so future sessions benefit from what was learned

tools.name: prompt_validate
tools.description: Check a task description for clarity and completeness before starting

tools.name: codeledger_replay
tools.description: Find how similar problems were solved before in this codebase

tools.name: codeledger_recent_flows
tools.description: See what the agent has been doing recently in this session

tools.name: codeledger_flow_explain
tools.description: Understand why a particular past solution was retained and considered useful

tools.name: codeledger_reason
tools.description: Get a structured, codebase-aware answer to a question about the code

tools.name: codeledger_system_map
tools.description: See how components relate — what depends on what, and what a change would affect

tools.name: codeledger_context_pointers
tools.description: Find the best starting points for working in an unfamiliar area of the codebase

tools.name: codeledger_execution_prompt
tools.description: Get a step-by-step execution plan tailored to the current task and codebase

tools.name: panel_snapshot
tools.description: See the full current session state — active files, session health, and suggested next steps

tools.name: panel_brief
tools.description: Get a concise summary of what CodeLedger knows right now — what's selected, what was learned, what to do next

tools.name: panel_handoff
tools.description: Hand off to another agent with everything it needs — key files, risks, and verification steps

skills.name: activate
skills.description: Activate CodeLedger context for a task

skills.name: refresh
skills.description: Refresh context when the task shifts

skills.name: current
skills.description: Inspect the current bundle, delta, and recent truth tail

skills.name: status
skills.description: Inspect session metrics and broker state

skills.name: explain
skills.description: Explain the latest bundle run and scoring signals

skills.name: refine
skills.description: Refine the bundle with learned context mid-session

skills.name: bundle
skills.description: Generate a context bundle without writing to active-bundle
